use default

to_text(bytes: List[ubyte]) -> string =>
    string(bytes |> map(b => cast char(b)) |> collect_array())

replace_byte(
    bytes: List[ubyte], old: ubyte, replacement: ubyte
) -> LIST[ubyte] is
    let result = LIST[ubyte]()

    for b in bytes do
        result.add(if b == old then replacement else b fi)
    od

    result
si

join_bytes(a: List[ubyte], b: List[ubyte]) -> LIST[ubyte] is
    let result = LIST[ubyte](a)

    for b2 in b do
        result.add(b2)
    od

    result
